sentences.text: API version 2 became generally available on 2025-11-04, and version 1 remains supported until 2026-11-04.
Version 1 is deprecated and will be switched off on 2026-11-04, which is twelve months after v2 became available.
The general rule is that breaking changes are introduced only in a new major version, and the previous major version is supported for 12 months after the new one is released.
